scientific_integrity: Point-coloring signs are over F_2, convolution is unnormalized over 2^16 binary incidence coordinates, and all inverse and norm calculations use exact integers. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for the affine 2-flats in F_2^4; no infinite-family claim. The eight-value multiplier classification has a structural proof, while the inverse-kernel coefficient table is independently verified by exhaustive integer Walsh inversion. Historical-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed Reed–Muller code association-scheme spectra.
title: Eight-level zero-free Walsh spectrum for the classical sixteen-point Steiner quadruple system
